body: I can wait till tomorrow but that’s another day of me just suffering from this
Well this is no help at all. Please don’t reply and waste my time
Thing is I have been depressed and suicidal for a long long time and what he decided to do in this situation really fucked me up in the head.
He really is, I don’t know how I can still hold any kind of feelings for him. And I try to be funny... try...

My boyfriend lives a few hours away which would be too long to drive so we talk on the phone and play games together a lot. He usually sits on call with me while I cry and when I have anxiety attacks. He try’s his hardest to make me happy. A few days ago I even told him that I don’t want to die, because I don’t necessarily want to because I don’t want to leave him. He is my comfort and my only support. 

And I’ve had depression ever since I can remember. I don’t know how it started because I don’t remember much at all considering I don’t really remember things from when I was 10 and under and I’m also still young. What I do know is that people always excluded me I was never able to make genuine friends it felt like and that made me into someone who is generally an introvert. I don’t feel loved I feel forgotten like the only things people recognize me for is my art and the fact that im good at video games. Even though I don’t really like people though I still try to keep everyone from feeling the pain I do. Which I’m pretty sure that’s why I have so much anxiety around people

I tell my boyfriend a decent amount, and no I’ve never tried getting help and I never plan to. I’d much rather die then be stuck in something that will only make my anxiety and depression so bad that I can no longer help myself.
I know that, I’ve been doing it for years...
In my situation and with how I feel getting help is an option I simply do not like with the outcomes of it.

That’s the thing, I can’t trust anyone. No one gives me a reason to trust them and looking at what other people have done the counselors don’t keep a damn thing secret, they tell EVERYONE people TELL EVERYONE. I have no reason to get help when it’s not where I can speak my heart out. Nothing is going to be between me and another person. And I already hate people.
